resolution.note: transport test: plain gh call bound 30 s, log bound longer

title: A gh call through the app-token wrapper gets a bound a loaded host meets
body:
Source: lead 2026-11-16 01:30: `krn pr ship` failed exit 70 `spawnSync gh ETIMEDOUT` three times overnight (S9 lane on #1116 twice, lead follow-up ship once) at host load 90-128. Every gh call goes through scripts/app-bin/gh, which starts node to read the app token; `gh api rate_limit` took 6.0 s at load 116 against GH_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 s, and four retries did not help.
Outcome: one gh call has a bound that a loaded host meets (30 s), and the bound still stops a hung gh.
Proof: test/deliver transport test asserts a plain call gets at least 30 s and a log download keeps its longer bound.
Files: src/deliver/transport.ts, test/deliver
